channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Biggest-ever crypto hack impacts $6.3 billion as Binance works to contain fallout
item.description: Binance estimated the impact of a security incident at $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in crypto assets frozen, and pledged to cover all losses.

item.title: Nasdaq-100 futures fall 2% as Amazon and Intel tumble after earnings: Live updates
item.description: Amazon and Intel shares tumbled after the companies posted their latest earnings reports.

item.title: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
item.description: Iran said four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, while Tehran disputed a U.S. claim that key shipping lanes had been cleared.

item.title: A pharma giant is moving past one patent cliff — but another is already looming
item.description: Disappointing data highlights Novartis' challenge to build its next generation of blockbuster medicines, following a series of clinical trial setbacks.

item.title: Israel faces weeks of coalition haggling as Netanyahu’s party claims election 'stolen'
item.description: Israel's election leaves the country facing weeks of coalition bargaining and an uphill battle for the opposition party to form a majority government.

item.title: BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
item.description: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.

item.title: Firm that correctly called the AI rally slowdown says here's where to hide out
item.description: Whether or not the artificial intelligence trade is in a bubble, there are defensive parts of the market to hide in if it bursts, according to Capital Economics.

item.title: DOJ escalates Alaska Senate lawsuit over dueling Sullivan candidacies
item.description: Alaska's election could determine which party has a majority in the Senate. GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan faces a strong challenge from Democrat Mary Peltola.

item.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, holds 2026 capex unchanged
item.description: Amazon's negative free cash flow ballooned during the third quarter, while its earnings and revenue fell short of Wall Street's expectations.

item.title: Intel stock plunges 21% as chipmaker blames PC slowdown for weak guidance
item.description: Intel has been a Wall Street darling this year due to its emergence as a player in AI, but the company is being weighed down by a struggling PC market.

item.title: How elections worldwide are testing Trump’s influence abroad
item.description: Recent election losses by leaders linked to Trump have prompted questions about whether his influence over the global right is weakening.

item.title: It's a 'socialist' bank — and North Dakota Republicans love it
item.description: Democratic socialist candidates have held up North Dakota's state-owned bank as a model to emulate.

item.title: Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt as it pursues AI buildout
item.description: Microsoft boasts a strong credit rating and has managed to maintain positive free cash flow, unlike Meta, Alphabet and Amazon.

item.title: ServiceNow shares plunge 27% to worst day ever after earnings revive AI disruption fears
item.description: ServiceNow's stock recorded its worst day ever on underwhelming third-quarter results.

item.title: West Pharma earnings show it's more than a GLP-1 play. Why we see more upside
item.description: Since CNBC highlighted the stock's attractive valuation in August, shares have gained around 20%. Why we expect more upside ahead.

item.title: IRS CEO Bisignano donates to Trump Accounts in his childhood Brooklyn ZIP code
item.description: IRS CEO Frank Bisignano has donated to Trump Accounts for Brooklyn kids from his hometown ZIP code. Here's what families need to know.

item.title: Intel plunges on a major guidance miss. What went wrong — and how to proceed
item.description: Further downside is certainly possible, but selling now won't erase the losses we've taken.

item.title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
item.description: Amazon's cloud signed deals with Meta and OpenAI during the quarter, helping revenue to exceed consensus.

item.title: Alphabet tanks nearly 13% for worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value
item.description: Alphabet reported a larger negative free cash flow than analysts had expected while maintaining its spending gudiance for the year.

item.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
item.description: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.

item.title: Jim Cramer: Why investors are punishing Alphabet and giving Microsoft a pass
item.description: Microsoft is faring better because of its financial spending, Jim Cramer said Thursday, a day after earnings.

item.title: A sinking fund can help you avoid holiday debt. Here are the best ways to start
item.description: Start saving now to spread holiday costs across paychecks and reduce the need to borrow.

item.title: Reddit shares sink on weak sales guidance and plans login requirement test as Google search traffic shrinks
item.description: Reddit posts third-quarter earnings and reveals plans to require all users to create official accounts as Google search traffic shrinks

item.title: Rivian third-quarter earnings beat estimates as software revenue, R2 deliveries rise
item.description: Rivian also revised its 2026 guidance to mark expected improvements in its vehicle deliveries, pre-tax adjusted earnings and capital expenditures.

item.title: Friday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The S&P 500 snapped a three-day advance as shares of Alphabet sold off sharply on the back of earnings results.

item.title: Nvidia responds to report Jensen Huang was target of Chinese asset, says diversion allegations were 'investigated and debunked'
item.description: Nvidia disputed a New York Times report that U.S. intelligence agencies surveilled a person close to CEO Jensen Huang over concerns she could be a Chinese spy.

item.title: Starbucks sales miss expectations, but its U.S. turnaround is gaining steam
item.description: Starbucks' U.S. stores topped Wall Street's comparable sales expectations but its international business fell short of estimates.

item.title: Some Polymarket user funds stolen by hackers; exchange referring matter to U.K. authorities
item.description: The outage comes just days before the platform is expected to experience heightened trading during the U.S. midterm elections.

item.title: Steve Eisman gets more conservative with portfolio as AI trade nears 'tipping point'
item.description: The noted investor, famous from "The Big Short," says it would be "impossible" for an AI crash not to hurt the broader market

item.title: Cruise companies aim to keep fuel costs down. Their strategies for doing so differ
item.description: Carnival is cutting fuel use, while Royal Caribbean and Norwegian rely on "hedging" to keep fuel costs down amid conflict in the Middle East.
